name: Steam Web API
tagline: Valve’s official HTTP API for Steam players, games, news, and app data
description: Valve’s Steamworks Web API exposes public and partner HTTP methods for Steam. Developers query player profiles, owned and recently played games, achievements/stats, VAC bans, news, and more via interface-style paths. Public methods use a free user API key; publisher keys unlock ownership, microtransactions, and other partner-only calls. Hosted at api.steampowered.com (partner.steam-api.com for publisher traffic).

auth.details: API key via query param key= or request header x-webapi-key. User keys: free self-serve at steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey (Steam account + domain, accept ToS). Publisher keys via Steamworks for protected methods. Some public methods need no key.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free API; 100,000 calls per day (Steam Web API Terms of Use)

rate_limits: 100,000 calls per day (official ToS); excess use may return HTTP 429 or access denials
use_cases: get Steam player profile summary by 64-bit SteamID
list a user's owned games and playtime
fetch global or player achievement/stats for an app
resolve a vanity profile URL to a SteamID
get recent news posts for a Steam app
check VAC/community ban status for SteamIDs
